title: ORDER APPROVING COMPENSATION RESET UNDER PERMIT NO. 932 WITH SOUTHERN CALIFORNIA EDISON COMPANY
text:
RESOLUTION NO. ____________ - ORDER APPROVING COMPENSATION RESET UNDER PERMIT NO. 932 WITH SOUTHERN CALIFORNIA EDISON COMPANY
Transmittal 1
Transmittal 2
Summary
: Staff requests approval of the Order resetting compensation under Permit No. 932 (Permit) with Southern California Edison Company (SCE) for the five-year period of September 10, 2025, through September 9, 2030, covering aerial space premises across the Intermodal Container Transfer Facility (ICTF) for the operation and maintenance of an overhead 220kV electrical power transmission line. Approval of the proposed compensation reset will retroactively increase rent effective September 10, 2025. Commencing September 10, 2025, rent will be increased to $96,864.00 per year, representing a 6.3 percent increase relative to the annual rent amount of $91,126.35 which was in effect as of September 9, 2025. Effective September 10, 2026, and annually thereafter, rent will be adjusted based on the year-over-year change in the Consumer Price Index (CPI), subject to a floor of zero percent. This permit is in alignment with Strategic Objective 3: Improved Financial Performance of Port Assets.
Recommendation
: Board resolve to 1) find that the Director of Environmental Management has determined that the proposed action is categorically exempt from the requirements of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) under Article III, Class 1(2) and 1(14) of the Los Angeles City CEQA Guidelines; 2) approve the Order resetting compensation under Permit No. 932 with Southern California Edison Company; 3) authorize the Board Secretary to attest to the Order resetting compensation under Permit No. 932; and 4) adopt Resolution No.___________ and Order No.___________.
Environmental Management
